scope: One explicitly operator-authorized new attempt for each of the 40 failed development LEAP requests; no successful observation or missing-evidence group is re-elicited
authorization: why did they 403? can you retry the failed runs and merge with the old results if they worked
stop_rule: Stop this batch at the first unsuccessful retry; never automatically retry a retry
merge_rule: Retain every original successful/skipped record; replace an originally failed record only with its successful authorized retry, preserving identical wire/request/group/evidence/model/prompt identity and source lineage
original_records: Remain immutable, including errors and private HTTP responses
evaluation_scope: Same existing development IDs only; no reserved evaluation access, new evidence or searches
